tools.name: create_youtube_clip
tools.description: Creates a public TubeChop link for an exact time range in a public YouTube video. Free clips expire after seven days.

youtube_url.description: A public YouTube URL or 11-character YouTube video ID.

start_seconds.description: The clip start time in seconds, including decimals.

end_seconds.description: The clip end time in seconds. It cannot exceed the source video duration and must be at least 0.5 seconds after start_seconds. The clip length (end_seconds minus start_seconds) cannot exceed 80% of the source video duration.

idempotency_key.description: A unique key for this intended clip, such as a UUID. Reuse it when retrying the same request.

comment.description: An optional note shown with the clip.
